record_title: Semifinite-gap Floquet selection in the trigonometric Nosé–Hoover orbit
provenance: A source-specific stability refinement of the exact central periodic orbit in arXiv:2609.19958v1. Its normal variational equation is identified with the s=1 Whittaker–Hill equation, yielding an exact spectral stability criterion, a semifinite-gap resonance selection rule, principal-tongue asymptotics, and a finite-coupling Floquet crossing matching the reported b=1/2 transition.
limitations: The result concerns linear transverse stability of the exact central orbit only. It does not establish nonlinear KAM stability, attraction, global basin structure, or a global mechanism for chaos. The b=1/2 finite-coupling threshold is numerical. Originality is assessed to the best of our knowledge.
